steps.title: Set up Project Structure
steps.description: Initializes the basic Android project structure with necessary directories and configuration files.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Files
steps.description: Updates the module-level build.gradle file with SDK versions, build tools, and other essential configurations for the app.

steps.title: Define Application Manifest
steps.description: Creates the AndroidManifest.xml file, declaring the application's package, activities, permissions, and theme.

steps.title: Design Calculator Display Layout
steps.description: Develops the XML layout for the main activity to display the input and results of calculations.

steps.title: Design Calculator Button Layout
steps.description: Adds a GridLayout to the main activity layout to arrange the numerical and operator buttons.

steps.title: Initialize MainActivity
steps.description: Creates the MainActivity.java file and sets up the basic class structure, including inflating the layout.

steps.title: Connect UI Elements to Java Code
steps.description: Finds TextView and Button references from the layout in MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Implement Number Button Logic
steps.description: Adds OnClickListener for number buttons to append digits to the display.

steps.title: Implement Operator Button Logic
steps.description: Adds OnClickListener for operator buttons (+, -, *, /) to handle operations and store current input.

steps.title: Implement Clear (C) Button Logic
steps.description: Adds OnClickListener for the 'C' button to clear the display and reset calculation state.

steps.title: Implement Equals (=) Button Logic
steps.description: Adds OnClickListener for the '=' button to trigger the calculation of the expression.

steps.title: Add Core Calculation Logic
steps.description: Develops a private method within MainActivity to parse the expression and perform the arithmetic calculation.

steps.title: Refine Display Handling
steps.description: Ensures proper formatting and error handling for the calculator's display.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Compiling and packaging the Android application.
